Lore: Relic Cauldron

Carved with reposing satyrs and nymphs holding ladles, the cauldron has fed more than one desperate Ten-Towns supper table through the darkest weeks of the Everlasting Rime.

A 4-foot copper cauldron on five clawed feet, holding up to 30 gallons. Stir water in it for 1 Minute and it becomes a hearty stew - one nourishing meal per gallon for up to 4 people. The stew stays hot inside the cauldron and cools naturally once removed; the cauldron itself never gets hot to the touch.

Usable 3 times, refreshing after a Rest.

It has the following Powers:

  • Endless Stew: Stir water in it for 1 Minute to fill it with hearty stew: one nourishing meal for up to 12 Beings. Usable 3 times, refreshing after a Rest.

Value: 1500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
